name: OXR (SoMark)
description: Parses PDFs and document images into Markdown or JSON with layout coordinates, tables, formulas and handwriting, via a self-hosted or free API. For agents and document pipelines.

skills.name: Document parsing
skills.description: Turns PDFs and document images into Markdown or JSON output, with layout coordinates included.

skills.name: Layout element recognition
skills.description: Recognizes 13 document element types with bounding boxes and reading order.

skills.name: Table parsing
skills.description: Extracts tables, including complex ones, as HTML or Markdown.

skills.name: Formula recognition
skills.description: Converts formulas and chemical equations in documents into LaTeX.
